**Thursday**, and the last day of the Book Fair. Tae Kwon Do is at 4:00, and it is Gear Week, so arrive already wearing your full gear.

**Friday** is the Costume Parade, owl pellets in Science, and Little Medical School after school. Tonight, flip through your Wordly Wise words once and say each meaning out loud before you check it. That quiz could come any day now.
